question: Why is the addressed power praised as the true path by the good?
premises: The good worship the addressed as the true being
Because of this worship the addressed is praised as true path
The conclusion is directed to the addressed
inference: The addressed is called the true path because the good worship her as the true being.
plain_english: Because the good, worshipping you as the true one, praise you as the true path, therefore you are so.
